[issue by nexquin] ### Minecraft Version 1.21.10 ### Mod Loader Fabric ### Describe the Issue Game launched via Modrinth app. Server hosted by Modrinth. Unable to edit the names of Waystones spawned in front of "Dungeons and Taverns" generated "Shrines". A red circle with a slash through it (I tried to take a screenshot but my cursor wouldn't show up) replaces the mouse pointer when hovering over the text field. Was the same if shift+right-clicked or by clicking the book icon to the right of the name field (it is always called"< unnamed>") in the Waystone GUI. Please let me know if this is something I can configure or if I need to delete the report since it's related to another mod. Thank you! ### Logs
